This Appeal, Coming On For Orders, This Day, The
Court Delivered The Following:
 Judgment
The learned counsel for the appellants has furnished the valuation slip, in which, it is shown that the award amount is Rs.12,69,304/- and the balance claim amount is Rs.6,11,147/-.
Hence, in view of Rule 19 of the Karnataka Civil Courts Act, 1964, the District Court has got jurisdiction to entertain this appeal.

Hence, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER
The Registrar Judicial is directed to transfer this case to the concerned jurisdictional District Court.
The Registry is also directed to transfer the court fee amount to the concerned jurisdictional District Court.
Accordingly, case is disposed of.

Sd/-
